newsitem.title: USA: Fujifilm launched new digital camera.
newsitem.headline: Fujifilm launched new digital camera.

text.p: Fuji Photo Film U.S.A. Inc Tuesday introduced the DS-7 Digital Camera, which allows users to view images before saving them to a floppy disk card.
On the back of the digital camera body is a 1.8-inch active matrix color LCD for viewing images before they are stored on a floppy disk card, called "SmartMedia," the company said.
The compact DS-7 Digital Camera, priced at $699, comes bundled with Adobe PhotoDeluxe image editing software that lets users add their own personal design touch to saved images, the company said.
The new digital camera is now available in computer stores, camera stores and consumer electronic stores.
Fuji Photo Film is the U.S. marketing subsidiary of Fuji Photo Film Co. Ltd. of Tokyo.
